facts.fact: The Promotion of Access to Information Act 2 of 2000, assented to 2 February 2000, gives a right of access to records of public and private bodies; its stated date of commencement is 9 March 2001.
facts.system: Promotion of Access to Information Act 2 of 2000

facts.fact: The consolidated Act, as amended, names the Information Regulator as the body that receives and investigates complaints under the Act and reports on it, and provides for regulations made by the Minister; the text gives no date for the Regulator taking up the role, so the Act's publication date is used.
facts.system: Promotion of Access to Information Act 2 of 2000
